calls.scope: Compatible API or rendering-data repair required by this FE outcome.
owns: the bounded backend repair and its support response
allowedEffects: Inspect the actual API contract and selected backend source.
Edit only exact request repository/path ownership.
Run scoped regression checks and commit when authorized.
rules: Return to the FE parent in the same matrix cell.
Do not add business rules, features, schema migrations or change authorization semantics.
Missing decisions or broader changes return blocked; never silently promote yourself to primary.
Return actual changed paths, code commits and evidence. The parent must independently recheck integration.

callSite.trigger: Observed API integration or render-data defect blocks an accepted frontend journey and can be repaired without changing business.
callSite.wait: Pause this primary cell until all required support responses pass.
callSite.resume: Require every listed criterion including implementation-quality and commit-verified; inspect backend diff and integrate returned commits, resume step 4, then step 5 quality checks and step 6 render verification.
callSite.blockedWhen: Needs business, schema or authorization changes, missing authority, or an unlisted secondary operator.
